📧 Got Bible Questions?

02:48 Could you please explain Paul's meaning in Colossians 2:16 & 17?  These bible verses are being used to prove that the Sabbath has been changed from Sunday or that God doesn't require a special day to worship just as long as worship Him.  

16:56 What did Leviticus 19:27 mean? What are the principles in that text also what are  EGW comments on that text?
